page_title: WOL 1-3 CRY | Wolves v Crystal Palace 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Wolves failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Toti did his best and is replaced by Enso Gonzalez (Wolves).
88' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Eberechi Eze is replaced by Joel Ward (Crystal Palace).
88' A substitution has been made. Michael Olise is replaced by Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace).
85' RED CARD! Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Thomas Bramall. He can have an early bath.
83' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Dean Henderson (Crystal Palace).
82' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
80' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolves comes to nothing. Wolves have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
79' Gary O'Neil decides to make a substitution. Matt Doherty will be replaced by Thomas Doyle (Wolves).
77' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) picks up a yellow card.
77' Oliver Glasner isn't happy on the touchline after referee Thomas Bramall shows him a yellow card.
73' 1 - 3 Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
71' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
71' Great teamplay by Wolves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
70' Oliver Glasner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) replacing Tyrick Mitchell.
69' It is time for a substitution. Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) is on for Jean-Philippe Mateta.
66' Referee Thomas Bramall points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) goes wild in celebration.
66' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) puts the ball into the back of the net, but referee Thomas Bramall immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
66' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Matheus Cunha (Wolves) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
66' Wolves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
65' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Wolves get a corner.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Ait-Nouri leaves the pitch and Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) comes on.
59' Mario Lemina (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.

58' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
55' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
52' Crystal Palace can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
50' A short through ball almost allows Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
48' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
46' That's the end of the game for Boubacar Traore, who is replaced by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' A cross from a corner kick by Wolves is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
45+2' One of the Crystal Palace players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' Joao Gomes (Wolves) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
44' Matt Doherty (Wolves) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!

42' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
41' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
40' The main referee, Thomas Bramall, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is given a yellow card for dissent.
40' Yellow card. Boubacar Traore (Wolves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
39' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
35' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
34' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
33' A pass into the penalty area from Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by the defence. Crystal Palace force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' 0 - 2 Goal! Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 0:2.
28' Post! Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
26' 0 - 1 Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) latches on to a superb pass and breaks through the defence before firing a shot from mid-range that goes past the goalkeeper inside the left post.

23' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.

19' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Dean Henderson was alert and the score remains the same.
17' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
16' Rayan Ait-Nouri loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves). The ball is behind the touchline and Wolves will take a throw-in.
14' Oliver Glasner is forced to make a change. Will Hughes is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace).
12' The injury to Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
11' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

9' Joao Gomes pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Max Kilman (Wolves) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
8' Joao Gomes (Wolves) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
2' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Crystal Palace will kick-off.
Thomas Bramall was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
